Ballynahinch Castle Hotel Connemara, Ireland
About Ballynahinch Castle
Welcome to Ballynahinch Castle Hotel, one of Ireland's finest luxury castle hotels and a member of Relais & Chateaux. Set in a private 700-acre estate of woodland, rivers and walks in the heart of Connemara, Co. Galway. This authentic and unpretentious Castle Hotel stands proudly overlooking its famous salmon fishery , with a backdrop of the beautiful 12 Bens Mountain range .
During your stay, relax in your beautifully appointed bedroom or suite with wonderful views, wake up to the sound of the river meandering past your window and enjoy breakfast in the elegant restaurant. The restaurant was awarded Ireland's Fine Dining Hotel Restaurant of the Year at the Gold Medal Awards in January 2024.
A stay in Ballynahinch Castle is the perfect destination for an activity break or simply relaxing by one of our six open log fires. Expert guides are available to assist in every activity, on the sea, in the mountains, on rivers and trails or in the library exploring the rich culture of this spectacular region.
Ballynahinch Castle Hotel is located along the Wild Atlantic Way in the West of Ireland. This makes us a perfect base for touring the 2,500km (1,500 miles) of amazing driving route from Donegal to Co. Cork. Local attractions in Connemara on the drive include Killary Harbour, Inishbofin, Sky Road and Roundstone village. Visit our Locations & Attractions page for more information.

From guided fly fishing and falconry to cycling, boat tours and tree planting, every experience is designed to help you connect with Ballynahinch and the landscape that surrounds it. Book your experience at the link in bio now.

Rooms & Suites
Few castle hotels in Ireland offer you hotel rooms with views to match Ballynahinch Castle in Connemara. Each of our 48 guest rooms and suites are individually decorated to a very high standard with soft furnishings to compliment the surroundings. The majority of our Classic rooms are located in the original house with three in the newer wing overlooking the grounds. The Classic rooms have views of the grounds, courtyard or mountains. All our Classic Riverside Rooms are located in the original house as are two of our Superior Rooms.
The remaining Superior, Luxury rooms and Riverside Suites are located in a newer wing, overlooking the river with magnificent views of the river & woodlands.
Our Superior rooms can accommodate a maximum of three people, all other categories can accommodate a maximum of two people.
Whichever room you choose you will find sleep comes easily in this luxurious accommodation in the heart of Connemara.
The hotel has one accessible room subject to availability. Please note that the hotel does not have a lift and some areas are not fully accessible. This is due to the Castle being a historical structure and a protected building, and these structural changes are not permitted.

Frequently Asked Questions
What can you expect from our Classic Rooms at Ballynahinch Castle?
Our Classic Rooms are cozy, warmly decorated and refurbished in 2019, these rooms are situated in the original house. They vary in shape, size, and aspects due to their location within the 1700s building. These rooms offer character and charm, complemented by hues that match the exterior views of the our beautiful Connemara lanscape.
What accessibility features and amenities do our Classic Rooms offer?
Our Classic Rooms are ONLY accessible by stairs due to them been located in the original part of the house. Guests can choose between Double or twin rooms with feather or feather-free options available.
Maximum occupancy of these rooms is two people and they can not accommodate extra beds or cots due to there size and shape. Our Superior Rooms option can be a better choice if you are looking to add a guest to the room. Please contact us directly at info@ballynahinch-castle.com to request a family room.
For a full list of room features click here.
What makes our Classic Riverside Rooms special?
These charming rooms are located in the historic original house, exuding character and warmth newly refurbished in 2019, Each room is individually decorated, drawing inspiration from the Connemara landscape that surrounds our castle hotel. Due to their placement in the original house, they vary in size and aspect, but all offer delightful river views.
Are our Classic Riverside Rooms accessible and what amenities do they include?
Classic Riverside Rooms are accessible via stairs ONLY. Guests can choose between King or Twin beds and feather or feather-free options.
Maximum occupancy is two people in these rooms, extra beds or cots are not available. I you require a family room please contact us directly at info@ballynahinch-castle.com for a full list of room features click here.
What can guests enjoy in our Superior Rooms?
Superior rooms are large and spacious, offering picturesque views of the river. Some of our Superior Doubles feature four-poster beds for an extra touch of elegance. Also, we offer interconnecting Superior rooms.
Two Superior rooms are situated in the original house. However, the river views from these rooms may be partially obscured by the surrounding woodlands.
For any specific room requests such as interconnecting please do contact the hotel directly at info@ballynahinch-castle.com , our team will be happy to check availability for you.
Special Requests: We have a limited number of rooms with four-poster beds. While you can request a room with a four-poster bed, availability is not guaranteed.
Bedding Preferences: Specify whether you'd like a twin room or a feather or feather-free bedding during booking.
What amenities are available in our Superior Rooms?
Superior Rooms come with bathrobes, slippers, and twin wash hand basins. Guests can enjoy the extra space, including a dressing room, a bathtub, and a walk-in shower.Whether you prefer feather or feather-free bedding, please specify your preference during booking. for a full list of room features click here.
Can Superior Rooms accommodate extra guests?
Yes! Some of our Superior rooms can accommodate an extra bed or cot. Maximum occupancy for these rooms is three people. Keep in mind that additional charges apply for the third guest. We also offer interconnecting rooms which are perfect for family getaways. Please contact our reservations team directly at info@ballynahinch-castle.com s o we can best accommodate you stay.
What defines our Luxury Rooms at Ballynahinch Castle?
Our luxury rooms are generously sized and offer glorious views of the river, garden, and woodlands. These rooms are meticulously finished to a superb standard, ensuring a comfortable and an elegant stay. Enjoy walk-through dressing rooms, separate bath and shower

About Ballynahinch Castle
About Us
Nestled in one of the most pictureque areas of West of Ireland is Ballynahinch Castle surrounded by 700 acres of woodland, river & lakes. Enjoy tranquil walks, a stroll in the Walled Garden or many of the other on-site activites including fly fishing, cycling, hiking or simply relax by an open log fire.
Located in the heart of Connemara, Ballynahinch Castle is a destination; where our guests do not have to leave the grounds from the moment they arrive. Walk through the front door of the hotel to be greeted by our friendly reception team and the warmth of one of our 6 open log fires which are a glow.
The estate has over 10 miles of scenic tranquil woodland, riverside & lakeside walks. The Connemara Greenway runs through the estate and is ideal for cycling, walking and running. Our guests can take one of our complimenatry bikes and head out for a morning or afternoon cycle. We offer guided estate walks with one of our own very knowledgable guides where guests will learn of our great history of the estate, see some archaeology along the way and depending on the time of year, some wild foraging on the estate.

Ballynahinch Castle Hotel Location
Location
Ballynahinch Castle is located in the tranquil setting of Connemara, surrounded by woodland and mountains overlooking the Owenmore River. Located a short drive from the Capital of Connemara, Ballynahinch is the perfect base to explore Connemara and the Wild Atlantic Way .
For more information on travel, transfers or how to make the most of your time here at Ballynahinch Castle, please contact our concierge
For a full list of nearby attractions, please see our Attractions Page .
From Galway
As you leave Galway, follow the N59 signposted Clifd https://www.ballynahinch-castle.com/en/attractions/must-sees/clifden/76-75/ en. You will drive through the villages of Moycullen, Oughterard and a small crossroad village of Maam Cross, and continue forward on the N59. You will reach the village of Recess, which is a small village. After Recess, take the R341 turn to your left, signposted Roundstone / Ballynahinch. The hotel is 3 miles up this road on the right.

Public Transport links to Ballynahinch Castle Hotel & Estate
Arriving from Dublin:
From Dublin, there is public transport available to our nearest city, Galway.
Buses are available hourly from Dublin Airport and Dublin City's Eden Quay and Bachelor's Walk via Citylink .
Trains are available daily from Dublin's Connolly Station and Dublin's Heuston Station. Timetable available via IrishRail .
Arriving from Shannon Airport:
From Shannon Airport, there is public transport available to our nearest city, Galway.
Buses are available daily from Expressways route 51/X51. Timetable available here .
Arriving from Knock Airport:
From Ireland's West Airport, Knock, there is public transport available to our nearest city, Galway.
Buses are available daily from Expressways Route 64.
Arriving from Galway:
The daily bus services, Citylink's route 923 & Bus ireann's route 419, run from Galway city to the nearby town of Clifden. Citylink timetable available here . Bus ireann timetable available here .
Arriving from Clifden:
Once you arrive in Clifden, taxis are available to bring you directly to the hotel. Please call reception ahead of your arrival to arrange this.

wikipedia.title: Ballynahinch Castle
wikipedia.extract: Ballynahinch Castle is a former Irish country house and estate, built on the site of a former castle, which is now a luxury hotel set in a private estate in the Connemara region of County Galway, Ireland. The castle lies on the edge of Ballynahinch Lake and Ballynahinch River, and is directly overlooked by Benlettery 557 metres (1,827 ft), one of the Twelve Bens mountain range.
